    Copy the requirements from your application portal. We check the file; you check that it looks right.

    Read the preparation guide →
    What if my file cannot fit the size range?

    We test JPG quality settings from 100% down to 45% at your chosen dimensions. If none fit, we explain the problem. PNG does not have the same quality control. Try JPG if allowed, a different crop, or a better original. We never pad the file with meaningless bytes.

    Will my photo or signature be uploaded?

    The tools process images in your browser. The application code does not upload images, filenames, or previews. The hosting provider still receives ordinary page requests.

    Does passing mean the portal will accept it?

    No. We check format, pixel dimensions and byte size only. Readability, background, face position, photo age, DPI and other portal rules still need your review.
